The Rajasthan High Court Stenographer Result 2026 has been declared on 24 November 2026 by the Rajasthan High Court, Jodhpur. The result has been released for the Shorthand Test and Computer Test (Speed & Efficiency Test) conducted from 27 October to 4 November 2026. Candidates who appeared for Stenographer Grade-III (Hindi/English) in District Courts and Stenographer Grade-II (Hindi) in District Legal Services Authorities (DLSAs) can download the official result PDF from hcraj.nic.in and check their roll numbers in the provisional interview shortlist.

The Rajasthan High Court has shortlisted 151 candidates for the interview stage, including 141 candidates for Stenographer (Hindi) and 10 for Stenographer (English). The result was issued through Notice No. RHC/Exam. Cell/Stenographer/2026/2817, dated 24 November 2026. The PDF also contains category-wise cutoff marks for Non-TSP and TSP areas. The interview date has not yet been announced.

How to Check Rajasthan High Court Stenographer Result 2026?

Candidates can follow these steps to download the result and check their qualifying status.

  1. Visit the official Rajasthan High Court website at hcraj.nic.in.
  2. Open the Recruitment section.

  6. Press Ctrl + F and enter your roll number.
  7. Check the relevant Hindi or English Stenographer list for your area.
  8. Review the category-wise cutoff marks.
  9. Download and save the PDF for future reference.

The High Court has not yet announced the interview date. Shortlisted candidates should continue checking the official recruitment notices for further updates.

  5. Original Document and Eligibility Verification
  6. Final Selection Under Applicable Recruitment Rules

The current result is for the Shorthand Test and Computer Test. It should not be treated as the final appointment or selection list.

IOCL Executive Final Result 2026 Selection Process

The IOCL Executive Recruitment 2026 selection process included a Computer Based Test, Group Discussion, Group Task and Personal Interview. Candidates were shortlisted for subsequent stages based on their CBT performance and the applicable eligibility criteria. The final merit list was to be prepared using the prescribed weightage of the selection components.

1. Computer Based Test

The Computer Based Test assessed candidates in the prescribed general aptitude and domain knowledge areas. Candidates were required to obtain the minimum section-wise and overall qualifying marks for their category to become eligible for further consideration.

2. Group Discussion and Group Task

Candidates shortlisted through the CBT were considered for Group Discussion and Group Task. This component carried 5% weightage in the overall selection score and required the prescribed minimum qualifying marks.

3. Personal Interview

Shortlisted candidates also participated in a Personal Interview, which carried 10% weightage. Candidates were required to meet the prescribed qualifying standard in this stage.

4. Final Merit List

Final merit was based on the weighted composite score from CBT, Group Discussion and Group Task, and Personal Interview, subject to qualifying requirements, eligibility verification and other recruitment conditions.

UPSSSC Excise Constable Selection Process 2026

The UPSSSC Excise Constable recruitment involves multiple stages to assess candidates' examination performance, physical eligibility and supporting documents.

  2. Main Written Examination: Candidates appear for the written recruitment examination.
  3. Physical Measurement/Standard Test: Shortlisted candidates must meet the required physical measurements.
  4. Physical Efficiency Test: Candidates complete the prescribed physical efficiency assessment.
  5. Document Verification: The authority verifies educational, identity and eligibility documents.
  6. Final Selection: The Commission completes the selection process according to the recruitment rules.

Clearing the Main Written Examination is not equivalent to final appointment. Candidates must satisfy all applicable requirements in the remaining stages.

After the declaration of the UPSSSC Excise Constable Mains Result 2026, shortlisted candidates should prepare for the physical examination stages.

After completing the required physical tests, eligible candidates will proceed through document verification and other applicable recruitment formalities. Final selection will be determined according to the rules governing Advertisement No. 08-Exam/2026.

Difference Between UPSSSC Excise Constable Mains Result and Final Result

The UPSSSC Excise Constable Mains Result 2026 identifies candidates shortlisted from the written examination for the next recruitment stage.

The final recruitment result will be determined only after completion of the prescribed physical examinations, eligibility checks and remaining selection procedures.

Therefore, candidates whose results indicate qualification for physical tests should not treat this as a final appointment confirmation.

Personal passwords, OTPs and other sensitive login details should not be shared with unauthorised websites.

📄 Complete Details & Notification

BHEL Recruitment 2026: Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited (BHEL) has released two recruitment notifications for 415 Engineer Trainee, Executive Trainee and Supervisor Trainee posts under its 2027 recruitment programme. The vacancies include 200 Engineer/Executive Trainee posts under Advertisement No. 02/2026 and 215 Supervisor Trainee posts under Advertisement No. 03/2026. Candidates with relevant Engineering Degrees, Engineering Diplomas, Bachelor's Degrees in Business Administration, HR-related postgraduate qualifications, B.Com., CA or CMA qualifications can apply depending on the position. The maximum age limit is 27 or 29 years, subject to post-specific conditions and applicable relaxation. Online applications will be accepted from 25 November 2026 at 10:00 AM to 28 December 2026 at 11:45 PM through the official BHEL Careers website, careers.bhel.in.

The BHEL Engineer and Supervisor Trainee Recruitment 2026 covers Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, Civil, IT/Computer Science, HR and Finance disciplines. Engineer/Executive Trainees will receive a starting basic pay of Rs. 50,000 during one-year training, while Supervisor Trainees will receive Rs. 32,000. After successful training, the basic pay will be Rs. 60,000 for Engineer/Executive Trainees and Rs. 33,500 for Supervisors. The selection process includes a Computer-Based Examination (CBE), followed by an interview for Engineer/Executive Trainees or document verification for Supervisor Trainees. The tentative examination date is 27 January 2027. Candidates should read the relevant official notification carefully before applying.

BHEL Executive Trainee HR Qualification 2026

Candidates must possess both of the following qualifications:

  • A full-time regular Bachelor's Degree from a recognized Indian university with at least 60% aggregate marks.
  • A two-year full-time regular postgraduate Degree or Diploma in HR, Personnel Management, Industrial Relations, Social Work or an MBA, with at least 55% aggregate marks.

Candidates with postgraduate qualifications in Social Work or Business Administration must have studied Personnel Management, Labour Welfare or HRM as a specialization or elective in their final year.

BHEL Executive Trainee Finance Qualification 2026

Candidates must be qualified Chartered Accountants (CA) or Cost and Management Accountants (CMA) from institutions recognized by the appropriate statutory authorities in India.

A B.Com. degree alone does not satisfy the eligibility requirements for Executive Trainee (Finance).

Can Final-Year Students Apply?

Yes. The notifications permit candidates in the final year or semester of their qualifying course to apply.

However, shortlisted candidates must provide proof of having passed the required examination by the document verification stage. Candidates unable to produce the prescribed certificates or marksheets by that stage will be disqualified.

BHEL Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

The selection process is different for Engineer/Executive Trainee and Supervisor Trainee posts.

BHEL Engineer/Executive Trainee Selection Process 2026

Selection includes a Computer-Based Examination and interview.

  1. Online application and eligibility scrutiny.
  2. Computer-Based Examination (CBE).
  3. Shortlisting for interview in a 1:5 ratio, based on vacancies, discipline and reservation category.
  4. Personal interview.
  5. Verification of documents and eligibility.
  6. Final merit preparation and medical fitness assessment.

BHEL Supervisor Trainee Selection Process 2026

Supervisor Trainees will undergo a two-stage selection procedure:

  1. Computer-Based Examination (CBE).
  2. Document Verification / Scrutiny for shortlisted candidates.

Candidates will be shortlisted for document verification in the ratio of 1:3 based on their CBE performance, discipline, vacancies and reservation category.

Can Freshers Apply for NHPC Trainee Engineer Recruitment 2026?

Yes, fresh Engineering graduates can apply for NHPC Trainee Engineer Recruitment 2026 if they have completed the prescribed Engineering qualification with the required marks and possess a valid GATE 2025 or GATE 2026 score in the relevant paper. Previous work experience is not mandatory. However, candidates who are still appearing in their final-year Engineering examination are not eligible for this recruitment.

The NHPC Trainee Engineer Recruitment 2026 eligibility conditions are based on educational qualifications, valid GATE examination scores, age and reservation requirements. Candidates must possess a full-time Engineering Degree in the prescribed discipline or an eligible AMIE qualification. Only the notified Engineering disciplines and corresponding GATE paper codes are accepted.

NHPC has prescribed a full-time regular Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Technology or B.Sc Engineering in the relevant discipline from a recognised Indian university or AICTE-approved institution. An eligible AMIE qualification with enrolment up to 31 May 2013 is also accepted. Candidates must have secured at least 60% marks, relaxed to 50% for eligible SC, ST and PwBD candidates.

NHPC Trainee Engineer Salary 2026

The NHPC Trainee Engineer Salary 2026 is based on E2 Grade with a pay scale of Rs.50,000–1,60,000 under the IDA pattern. Selected candidates will receive this pay scale during the one-year training period. On successful completion of training, they will be absorbed as Engineers in the same pay scale, with a probation period of one year. The approximate annual emoluments for a new employee are Rs.16–17 lakh.

In addition to basic pay, selected employees will be eligible for Dearness Allowance, House Rent Allowance, Cafeteria Allowance, Performance Related Pay, medical facilities and social security benefits such as Provident Fund, pension and gratuity according to the applicable company rules.

Note: The approximate annual emoluments of Rs.16–17 lakh are not the same as the monthly in-hand salary. Actual take-home pay will depend on applicable allowances and deductions.

NHPC Trainee Engineer Selection Process 2026

The NHPC Trainee Engineer Selection Process 2026 consists of shortlisting through GATE 2025 or GATE 2026 scores, followed by Group Discussion and Personal Interview. Candidates with a valid score in the corresponding GATE paper will be considered for shortlisting based on the normalised marks out of 100. The final merit will be prepared using the prescribed weightage for GATE, Group Discussion and Personal Interview.

1. GATE Score-Based Shortlisting

NHPC will shortlist candidates based on the best valid normalised marks obtained in GATE 2025 or GATE 2026. Ordinarily, candidates up to five times the number of advertised vacancies in each category and discipline may be called for the next selection stages. If candidates have equal marks at the shortlisting boundary, all such candidates may be called according to the notification.

2. Group Discussion

Shortlisted candidates will be invited for Group Discussion. Group Discussion carries 5% weightage in the final selection score. There is no separate qualifying cut-off for Group Discussion, but candidates must satisfy the combined minimum qualifying requirements for Group Discussion and Personal Interview.

3. Personal Interview

Candidates shortlisted through GATE will also appear for a Personal Interview carrying 20% weightage. Candidates must submit the prescribed consent form and attend the selection process according to the schedule communicated by NHPC.

4. Psychometric Assessment, If Required

NHPC may conduct an online or offline Psychometric Assessment for candidates shortlisted for Group Discussion and Personal Interview. The assessment results may be used as an input during the interview.

5. Document Verification and Final Selection

Candidates must produce the required educational, category, GATE and other supporting documents during the selection process. Final empanelment will depend on the prescribed composite merit, minimum qualifying standards, document verification and other eligibility conditions.

NHPC Trainee Engineer Selection Weightage 2026

NHPC has prescribed a combined selection weightage of 75% for GATE 2025 or GATE 2026 normalised marks, 5% for Group Discussion and 20% for Personal Interview. The final score will be calculated out of 100 using these components.

Candidates who do not qualify in the combined Group Discussion and Personal Interview score will not be considered for final empanelment, regardless of their GATE marks.

The NHPC Trainee Engineer Recruitment 2026 does not prescribe a separate NHPC written examination. Selection is based on valid GATE 2025 or GATE 2026 scores in Civil, Electrical or Mechanical Engineering, followed by Group Discussion and Personal Interview. NHPC Trainee Engineer Service Bond 2026

Candidates selected under NHPC Trainee Engineer Recruitment 2026 must execute a service agreement and surety bond to serve the organisation for a minimum of four years, including the training period. The bond amount varies according to the candidate's category.

Candidates should carefully read the service bond conditions before accepting an appointment.

Documents Required for NHPC Trainee Engineer Recruitment 2026

Candidates applying for NHPC Trainee Engineer Recruitment 2026 must upload scanned copies of the prescribed documents through the online application portal. The documents must be clear and readable, and the information must match the details entered in the application form.

  • Matriculation or Secondary School Certificate as Proof of Date of Birth

  • Valid GATE 2025 or GATE 2026 Scorecard

  • Scanned Signature

The official notification prescribes PDF files of 100 KB to 400 KB for supporting certificates. The passport-size photograph must be uploaded in JPEG format with a file size below 50 KB, while the signature must be below 25 KB.

NHPC Trainee Engineer Apply Online 2026

The NHPC Trainee Engineer Apply Online 2026 process will begin on 27 November 2026 at 10:00 AM for 205 Civil, Electrical and Mechanical vacancies. Eligible candidates with valid GATE 2025 or GATE 2026 scores can submit their applications through the official NHPC Careers website until 26 December 2026 at 5:00 PM. Candidates must enter the correct GATE registration number, select the appropriate post and upload all supporting documents.

NHPC Trainee Engineer Recruitment 2026: Official Apply Online Website

Important: Candidates applying for Electrical or Mechanical vacancies in both NHPC and NHDC must submit separate applications. The prescribed application fee, where applicable, will be charged separately for each application.

How to Apply for NHPC Trainee Engineer Recruitment 2026?

Eligible candidates can submit their NHPC Trainee Engineer application forms through the official NHPC Careers website. Follow the steps below.

  1. Visit the official NHPC website at nhpcindia.com.
  2. Open the Careers section.
  3. Find Advertisement No. NH/Talent Acquisition/07/2026 for Trainee Engineer Recruitment 2026.
  4. Download and read the complete recruitment notification.
  5. Check the educational qualification, GATE paper code, minimum marks, age limit and category requirements.
  6. Open the online registration link when activated on 27 November 2026.
  7. Enter personal details, contact information and the valid GATE 2025 or GATE 2026 registration number.
  8. Select the appropriate Engineering discipline and NHPC or NHDC vacancy, as applicable.
  9. Enter the required academic qualifications and GATE normalised marks out of 100.
  10. Upload the prescribed educational certificates, GATE scorecard, category certificates and other documents.
  11. Upload the passport-size photograph and signature according to the specified file requirements.
  12. Review the complete application form carefully.
  13. Pay the applicable registration fee if required.
  14. Submit the online application before 26 December 2026 at 5:00 PM.
  15. Save the system-generated unique registration number and print the registration form for future reference.

Important: Candidates are not required to send the printed registration form or supporting documents by post. Applications will be accepted only through the prescribed online process.

NHPC Trainee Engineer Training and Job Location 2026

Selected Trainee Engineers will undergo one year of training in E2 Grade with a pay scale of Rs.50,000–1,60,000. After successful completion of training, they will be absorbed as Engineers in the same pay scale and placed on probation for one year.

Selected candidates may be posted at NHPC or NHDC projects, power stations, offices, joint ventures or subsidiary companies in different parts of India or abroad, according to organisational requirements.

Important Instructions for NHPC Trainee Engineer Applicants

Candidates applying for NHPC Trainee Engineer Recruitment 2026 should carefully follow the official instructions regarding eligibility, GATE scores, documents, application fees and the selection procedure.

  • A total of 205 Trainee Engineer vacancies have been announced.
  • The recruitment includes 188 NHPC and 17 NHDC vacancies.
  • Only candidates with valid GATE 2025 or GATE 2026 scores are eligible.
  • Civil applicants must have GATE paper code CE, Electrical applicants EE and Mechanical applicants ME.
  • Candidates who appeared in both GATE 2025 and 2026 must submit their best valid score.
  • GATE scores from earlier years or other years are not accepted.
  • Final-year Engineering students are not eligible to apply.
  • The maximum age is 30 years as on 26 December 2026, before applicable relaxation.
  • Online applications open on 27 November 2026 at 10:00 AM.
  • The last date to submit the application is 26 December 2026 at 5:00 PM.
  • Separate applications are required for NHPC and NHDC Electrical or Mechanical vacancies.
  • Applicants must pay the applicable registration fee separately for each application unless exempted.
  • Shortlisting will be based on GATE normalised marks, followed by Group Discussion and Personal Interview.
  • Selected candidates must execute the prescribed four-year service bond.
  • Candidates must meet the applicable medical fitness standards.
  • Applicants should regularly check the official NHPC website for recruitment updates.

📄 Complete Details & Notification

EIL Recruitment 2026: Engineers India Limited (EIL), a Navratna Government of India undertaking, has released Advertisement No. HRD/Rectt./Advt./2026-27/12 for recruitment to 87 Associate Engineer Grade I and Grade II posts on a fixed-term basis. The vacancies are available in Electrical, Instrumentation, Piping, Civil, Structural, Safety, Environment, Mechanical, Process and other engineering disciplines. Candidates possessing a BE, B.Tech or B.Sc. Engineering degree with a minimum of 60% marks and two or five years of relevant post-qualification experience can apply, depending on the position. The maximum age is 32 years for Grade I and 37 years for Grade II, before applicable relaxation. Selected candidates will receive consolidated monthly remuneration ranging from Rs. 57,600 to Rs. 80,000, depending on their grade and posting city. Online applications open on 25 November 2026 at 2:00 PM and close on 9 December 2026 at 2:00 PM through the official EIL recruitment portal.

The Engineers India Limited Associate Engineer Recruitment 2026 will be conducted through application screening and a personal interview. Walk-in interviews will be organized at EIL offices in Gurugram, Mumbai, Chennai, Kolkata, Bengaluru and Vadodara. Candidates must complete online registration before attending the interview and carry six printed copies of their submitted application along with original educational, experience and other required certificates. The appointment is initially for two years and may be extended up to a maximum total period of three years, subject to organizational requirements and satisfactory performance. The exact interview date, reporting instructions and venue will be communicated separately to registered candidates by email.

EIL Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF

Engineers India Limited has published the detailed eight-page recruitment advertisement HRD/Rectt./Advt./2026-27/12 for experienced engineers on a fixed-term basis.

Instrumentation candidates should preferably possess experience in design and engineering of instrumentation and control systems. Experience with smart platforms is desirable.

Am I Eligible for Coconut Development Board Recruitment 2026?

Before applying for Coconut Development Board Recruitment 2026, candidates should check whether they meet the educational qualification, age limit, experience and skill requirements for their preferred post. Eligibility conditions vary across Group A, Group B and Group C positions.

Age Limit Maximum 27, 30, 35 or 40 years, depending on the post. Applicable age relaxations are as per government rules and the notification.
Experience Relevant experience is required for certain posts. Some Group C posts do not prescribe prior work experience.
Skill Requirements Typing, shorthand or computer data entry proficiency is required for specific posts.

Can Freshers Apply for Coconut Development Board Recruitment 2026?

Yes, freshers can apply for Field Officer, Stenographer Grade II, Data Entry Operator and Lower Division Clerk posts, provided they meet the respective educational qualifications and skill requirements. The notification does not prescribe prior work experience for these posts.

Important: This is a quick eligibility guide, not a confirmation of individual eligibility. Candidates should check the detailed post-wise eligibility conditions in the official notification before applying.

Coconut Development Board Detailed Eligibility Criteria 2026

Candidates applying for Coconut Development Board Recruitment 2026 must satisfy the educational qualification, relevant work experience, age limit and skill requirements specified for the post. The recruitment includes opportunities for 12th-pass candidates, graduates and postgraduates. However, several officer-level positions require relevant professional experience.

Coconut Development Board Educational Qualification 2026

The educational qualifications differ by post. Candidates applying for clerical and field positions must possess the prescribed academic qualifications and skills, while applicants for development, administrative and accounts positions must meet additional experience requirements.

Coconut Development Board Application Fee 2026

The application fee for Coconut Development Board Recruitment 2026 is Rs.300 for candidates who are not eligible for fee exemption. The payment must be made through SBI Collect. Applications from eligible SC, ST, PwBD, Ex-Servicemen and women candidates are exempted from the application fee.

Coconut Development Board Salary 2026

The Coconut Development Board salary varies according to the post and pay level. Selected candidates will be placed in pay levels ranging from Level 2 to Level 11, with prescribed basic pay scales starting at Rs.19,900 for Lower Division Clerk and Rs.67,700 for Deputy Director (Development). Coconut Development Board Selection Process 2026

The Coconut Development Board Recruitment 2026 notification refers to a written test or interview and includes specific typing, shorthand and computer speed requirements for certain posts. However, the notification does not provide a complete stage-wise selection procedure or a common written examination pattern for all 13 designations.

Candidates applying for Lower Division Clerk, Stenographer Grade II and Data Entry Operator should pay particular attention to the practical skill requirements mentioned in their eligibility criteria. The Board may issue further instructions regarding the recruitment process, examination schedule and assessment requirements on its official website.

Coconut Development Board Apply Online 2026

Eligible candidates can apply online for Coconut Development Board Recruitment 2026 through the official vacancy page at coconutboard.gov.in. The application must be submitted within 30 days from the date of publication of the advertisement in Employment News. Candidates should verify the active application link and closing date before completing the form.

Coconut Development Board Recruitment 2026: Official Apply Online Page

How to Apply for Coconut Development Board Recruitment 2026?

Applications must be submitted online through the Coconut Development Board website. Candidates can follow the steps below.

  1. Visit the official website at coconutboard.gov.in.
  2. Open the Vacancy section and locate the recruitment notification dated 6 November 2026.
  3. Read the eligibility conditions and application instructions.
  4. Open the relevant online application link.
  5. Complete the registration or application details as required by the portal.
  6. Enter the required personal, educational and experience details.
  7. Provide the documents and supporting information requested in the application.
  8. Pay Rs.300 through SBI Collect if the application fee is applicable.
  9. Review the information carefully before final submission.
  10. Submit the application within the notified deadline and retain a copy for future reference.

Important: These are general application steps based on the notification. Candidates must follow the exact instructions displayed on the official application portal. Incomplete applications and applications received after the deadline will be rejected.

Important Instructions for Coconut Development Board Applicants

Candidates should carefully review the official recruitment conditions before applying. The notification provides important instructions regarding age calculation, employer permission, application accuracy and transfer liability.

  • Applicants must satisfy all prescribed qualifications and experience requirements for their chosen post.
  • The closing date for online applications will be used to calculate the upper age limit according to the notification.
  • The application fee must be paid through SBI Collect by candidates who are not exempted.
  • Incomplete or late applications will be rejected.
  • Candidates employed in specified Government and public-sector organisations must produce a No Objection Certificate from their employer at the time of the written test or interview.
  • Selected employees may be transferred anywhere in India according to the Board's requirements.
  • Incorrect information or failure to meet eligibility conditions may result in rejection of candidature.

📄 Complete Details & Notification

NHPC Limited has released the notification for NHPC Trainee Engineer and Officer Recruitment 2026 through GATE 2026, offering 47 vacancies across Electronics and Communication, Environment, Information Technology, Geology and Geophysics disciplines. The recruitment includes 45 vacancies under the main vacancy table and two separately listed PwBD vacancies.

Engineering graduates, MCA holders and candidates with specified postgraduate science qualifications can apply, provided they meet the prescribed eligibility requirements and possess a valid GATE 2026 score. Online registration begins on 27 November 2026 at 10:00 AM and closes on 26 December 2026 at 5:00 PM through the official website, nhpcindia.com. Selected candidates will receive approximate annual emoluments of Rs. 16 to 17 lakh.

NHPC Trainee Engineer and Officer Recruitment 2026 Overview

NHPC Recruitment Through GATE 2026 Notification

NHPC Limited, a Navratna Central Public Sector Enterprise operating in the hydropower sector, issued Advertisement No. NH/Talent Acquisition/09/2026 on 25 November 2026 for the recruitment of Trainee Engineers and Officers in five technical disciplines.

Unlike recruitment drives that conduct a separate written examination, NHPC will shortlist candidates using normalized marks obtained out of 100 in the relevant GATE 2026 paper. Shortlisted applicants will participate in a Group Discussion and Personal Interview for final selection.

The appointment includes one year of training in E2 Grade, followed by absorption as an Engineer or Officer and a one-year probation period upon successful completion of training.

NHPC Recruitment Through GATE 2026 Notification PDF

NHPC has notified 47 vacancies, including 39 non-backlog vacancies and six backlog vacancies under Table 1-B, along with two separately listed PwBD vacancies under Table 1-C. Information Technology accounts for the highest number of vacancies, followed by Electronics and Communication and Environment.

NHPC Trainee Engineer and Officer Eligibility Criteria

Eligibility for NHPC recruitment through GATE 2026 depends on the discipline selected by the candidate. Applicants must possess the prescribed full-time regular educational qualification with the required marks and a valid GATE 2026 score in the corresponding examination paper.

Only Indian nationals are eligible. Candidates appearing in the final year of their qualifying examination cannot apply for this recruitment.

Educational Qualification

Post Name Required Qualification Minimum Marks
Trainee Engineer (E&C) Full-time regular Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Technology or B.Sc. (Engineering) in the prescribed Electronics and Communication disciplines, or eligible AMIE with enrolment up to 31 May 2013 60%
Trainee Engineer/Officer (Environment) Full-time regular B.E./B.Tech. in Environmental Engineering or M.Sc. in Environmental Science 60%
Trainee Engineer/Officer (IT) Full-time regular Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Technology or B.Sc. (Engineering) in Computer Science, Information Technology or Computer Engineering, or MCA 60%
Trainee Officer (Geology) Full-time regular M.Sc. in Geology or M.Tech. in Applied Geology, with Geology and Mathematics or Physics studied at graduation level 60%
Trainee Officer (Geophysicist) Full-time regular M.Tech. or M.Sc. (Tech) in Applied Geophysics, Exploration Geophysics or Geophysics 60%

The prescribed qualifications must be obtained from recognized Indian universities or institutions approved by AICTE, as specified in the advertisement. SC, ST and PwBD candidates are eligible with a minimum of 50% marks in the qualifying educational examination.

NHPC will consider only the educational disciplines specifically listed in the notification. Qualifications in other or equivalent disciplines are not accepted.

Eligible Engineering Branches for Electronics and Communication

Candidates applying for Trainee Engineer (E&C) must possess a qualification in one of the following approved disciplines:

  • Electronics and Communication
  • Electronics
  • Electronics and Telecommunication
  • Electronics and Power
  • Power Electronics
  • Electronics and Instrumentation
  • Instrumentation and Control

Applicants possessing AMIE are eligible under this discipline only if their enrolment was completed on or before 31 May 2013 and they satisfy the prescribed marks requirement.

Desirable Qualification for Environment Posts

In addition to the essential qualification of B.E./B.Tech. in Environmental Engineering or M.Sc. in Environmental Science, NHPC has specified MSW or MBA in Rural Management as a desirable qualification for Trainee Engineer/Officer (Environment).

The desirable qualification does not replace the prescribed essential educational qualification.

NHPC GATE 2026 Paper Codes and Score Requirements

A valid GATE 2026 score in the relevant examination paper is mandatory for all five disciplines. NHPC will use normalized GATE marks out of 100 for shortlisting and final merit calculation. GATE scores from any other year are not accepted.

Trainee Officer (Geophysicist) Geology and Geophysics GG

Applicants must enter their valid GATE 2026 registration number while completing the NHPC online application. Applications submitted with an invalid registration number will be rejected.

The upper age limit for all Trainee Engineer and Officer posts is 30 years as of 26 December 2026. Age relaxation is available to eligible reserved category candidates in accordance with the conditions specified in the official notification.

NHPC Trainee Engineer and Officer Salary 2026

NHPC Trainee Engineers and Officers will be placed in the E2 Grade pay scale of Rs. 50,000 to Rs. 1,60,000 with a 3% increment structure under the Industrial Dearness Allowance (IDA) pattern. The approximate annual emoluments for newly appointed employees will be Rs. 16 to 17 lakh.

Grade E2

Starting Basic Pay Rs. 50,000 per month
Approximate Annual Emoluments Rs. 16–17 Lakh

The compensation package includes basic pay and applicable benefits under NHPC company rules:

  • Dearness Allowance (DA)
  • House Rent Allowance (HRA)
  • Cafeteria Allowance
  • Performance Related Pay (PRP)
  • Medical facilities
  • Provident Fund (PF)
  • Pension and gratuity

After successfully completing one year of training, candidates will be absorbed as Engineers or Officers in the same pay scale and will undergo a one-year probation period.

NHPC Recruitment 2026 Application Fee

Candidates belonging to the General, EWS and OBC Non-Creamy Layer categories must pay Rs. 708, including applicable taxes. Women, SC, ST, PwBD and Ex-Servicemen candidates are exempted from paying the registration fee.

Additional bank charges, processing charges and applicable GST on such charges, if any, will be borne by the applicant. The registration fee is non-refundable under any circumstances.

NHPC Trainee Engineer Selection Process Through GATE 2026

NHPC will prepare the final selection merit list using GATE 2026 marks, Group Discussion and Personal Interview performance. GATE marks carry the highest weightage of 75%, while Group Discussion and Personal Interview together account for the remaining 25%.

Selection Weightage

Selection Component Weightage
GATE 2026 Normalized Marks (Out of 100) 75%
Group Discussion 5%
Personal Interview 20%
Total 100%

Shortlisting and Final Merit List

  1. GATE-based shortlisting: Candidates will be shortlisted according to normalized marks obtained in the corresponding GATE 2026 paper.
  2. Shortlisting ratio: Normally, candidates numbering up to five times the vacancies will be shortlisted. The ratio may be exceeded when candidates in the same discipline and category obtain equal marks at the shortlisting threshold.
  3. Consent form: Shortlisted applicants must submit their consent to participate in Group Discussion and Personal Interview within the notified schedule.
  4. Group Discussion and Personal Interview: Candidates must participate in both selection stages and satisfy the applicable combined qualifying marks.
  5. Psychometric assessment: Shortlisted candidates may undergo an online or offline psychometric assessment, the results of which will be used as an input during the interview.
  6. Final merit: Selection will be based on composite merit, reservation requirements, eligibility verification and availability of vacancies.
  7. Medical fitness: Selected candidates must satisfy the prescribed medical fitness standards of NHPC.

Failure to submit the consent form or attend the Group Discussion and Personal Interview will result in cancellation of candidature.

Minimum Qualifying Marks for Group Discussion and Interview

Category Minimum Combined GD and PI Marks
UR / OBC (NCL) / EWS 40%
SC / ST / PwBD 30%

NHPC has not prescribed a separate qualifying cutoff for Group Discussion. Candidates must secure the applicable combined qualifying marks in Group Discussion and Personal Interview to be considered for empanelment.

If candidates obtain identical final marks, preference in the merit list will be given to the older candidate. Meeting the minimum qualifying marks alone does not guarantee selection.

NHPC Trainee Engineer Service Bond

Selected candidates must execute a service agreement and surety bond requiring them to complete a minimum of four years of service with NHPC, including the one-year training period.

Category Service Bond Amount Minimum Service Period
UR / OBC (NCL) / EWS Rs. 4,00,000 plus applicable GST 4 Years
SC / ST / PwBD Rs. 2,00,000 plus applicable GST 4 Years

NHPC Trainee Engineer and Officer Job Location

NHPC may post selected candidates at its projects, power stations, offices, joint ventures or subsidiary companies located across India or abroad. Applicants should be prepared to work at locations assigned according to the company's requirements.

Engineering and postgraduate candidates interested in similar employment opportunities can also explore the latest government job notifications.

The dates, times and venues for Group Discussion and Personal Interview will be communicated to shortlisted candidates through their registered email addresses.

NHPC Trainee Engineer Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF

The official NHPC recruitment notification dated 25 November 2026 contains detailed information on the 47 Trainee Engineer and Officer vacancies, educational qualifications, reservation provisions, accepted GATE paper codes, selection criteria and application procedure.

Candidates should refer to Advertisement No. NH/Talent Acquisition/09/2026 through the Careers section of the official NHPC website before registering. Any corrigendum, addendum or subsequent recruitment update will be published on the official website.

NHPC Trainee Engineer and Officer Apply Online 2026

NHPC will open the online registration facility for Trainee Engineer and Officer recruitment through GATE 2026 on 27 November 2026 at 10:00 AM. Eligible candidates can submit their applications until 26 December 2026 at 5:00 PM.

Only candidates with a valid GATE 2026 score and registration number in the prescribed examination paper can register for the relevant discipline. Manual or paper applications will not be accepted.

How to Apply for NHPC Recruitment Through GATE 2026?

  1. Visit the NHPC official website at www.nhpcindia.com.
  2. Open the Careers section and locate Advertisement No. NH/Talent Acquisition/09/2026.
  3. Read the complete advertisement and verify your discipline-specific eligibility.
  4. Access the online registration form once the application window opens.
  5. Enter your personal details, educational qualifications and valid GATE 2026 registration number.
  6. Upload your recent photograph, signature and supporting certificates in the prescribed formats.
  7. Pay the applicable registration fee, unless exempted.
  8. Review all information and submit the completed online application.
  9. Download and retain the system-generated registration slip for future reference.

Applicants are not required to send printed registration forms or supporting documents through the post.

Documents Required for NHPC Online Registration

  • Matriculation or Secondary School Certificate as proof of date of birth.
  • Class 12, graduation and postgraduate mark sheets and certificates, as applicable.
  • Valid GATE 2026 scorecard.
  • SC, ST, OBC NCL or EWS certificate, where applicable.
  • Disability certificate issued by the competent authority, where applicable.
  • Certificate confirming full-time regular education, except where AMIE applies.
  • Grade or CGPA conversion certificate, wherever applicable.
  • No Objection Certificate for candidates employed in Government Departments, PSUs or Autonomous Bodies, as applicable.
  • Recent passport-size colour photograph and signature.
  • Other applicable declarations and supporting certificates specified in the advertisement.

Candidates must ensure that all scanned certificates are readable. Incomplete applications and applications containing invalid GATE registration numbers will be rejected.

Important Application Instructions

  • Only GATE 2026 marks in the specified examination paper will be accepted.
  • Applicants must complete the prescribed educational qualification by the application closing date.
  • Final-year appearing students are not eligible.
  • Candidates should keep their registered email address active for at least one year.
  • The category selected during online registration cannot be changed subsequently.
  • Eligible OBC NCL candidates must possess the prescribed certificate issued within six months from the closing date of the online application.
  • Candidates employed in Government Departments, PSUs or Autonomous Bodies must produce the required No Objection Certificate by the Group Discussion and Personal Interview stage if it is unavailable at the time of application.
  • Applicants should regularly check the official website for recruitment updates.

Recruitment-related queries may be sent to [email protected], as specified in the official advertisement.

📄 Complete Details & Notification

NHPC Limited has released the NHPC Trainee Officer Recruitment 2026 notification for 44 vacancies in Human Resources (HR), Public Relations (PR) and Law, including three posts under a special recruitment drive for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD). Recruitment will be based on UGC NET June 2026 and CLAT PG 2026 scores, followed by a Group Discussion and Personal Interview.

Eligible candidates can submit their applications through the official NHPC website at www.nhpcindia.com from 27 November 2026 at 10:00 AM until 26 December 2026 at 5:00 PM. Selected candidates will receive a pay scale of Rs. 50,000 to Rs. 1,60,000 under E2 Grade, with approximate annual emoluments of Rs. 16 to 17 lakh.

NHPC Trainee Officer Recruitment 2026 Overview

Organization Name NHPC Limited and NHDC Limited
Post Name Trainee Officer (HR, PR and Law)
Advertisement No. NH/Talent Acquisition/08/2026
Notification Date 25 November 2026
Total Vacancies 44
Qualification Relevant Postgraduate Degree, PG Diploma, MBA, MSW or LLB
Qualifying Examination UGC NET June 2026 or CLAT PG 2026
Maximum Age Limit 30 Years
Pay Scale Rs. 50,000 – 3% – Rs. 1,60,000 (IDA)
Annual Emoluments Approximately Rs. 16–17 Lakh
Selection Process Qualifying Exam Score, Group Discussion and Personal Interview
Application Mode Online
Application Start Date 27 November 2026
Last Date to Apply 26 December 2026
Official Website nhpcindia.com

NHPC Recruitment 2026 Notification

NHPC Limited, a Navratna Central Public Sector Enterprise, issued Advertisement No. NH/Talent Acquisition/08/2026 on 25 November 2026 to recruit Trainee Officers for NHPC and its joint venture, NHDC Limited.

The notification specifies that HR and Public Relations vacancies will be filled through UGC NET June 2026 scores, while Law vacancies require a valid CLAT PG 2026 score. Scores from other examination sessions or years will not be accepted.

Candidates appointed through this recruitment will undergo one year of training before being absorbed as Officers, subject to successful completion of the training period.

NHPC Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF

NHPC Trainee Officer Vacancy 2026

NHPC has announced 44 Trainee Officer vacancies, comprising 41 vacancies listed under Table 1-B of the official notification and three additional vacancies under the special recruitment drive for PwBD candidates.

Post-Wise Vacancy Details

Post Name Organization Vacancies (Table 1-B) Special PwBD Drive Total
Trainee Officer (HR) NHPC 25 2 27
Trainee Officer (PR) NHPC 2 0 2
Trainee Officer (Law) NHPC 12 0 12
Trainee Officer (Law) NHDC 2 1 3
Total 41 3 44

Category-Wise Vacancies

Post UR EWS OBC (NCL) SC ST Total
HR (NHPC) 14 2 7 2 0 25
PR (NHPC) 1 0 0 1 0 2
Law (NHPC) 6 1 1 3 1 12
Law (NHDC) 1 0 1 0 0 2
Total 22 3 9 6 1 41

The category-wise table excludes the three additional special PwBD recruitment vacancies. The ST vacancy for Trainee Officer (Law) in NHPC is a backlog vacancy from Recruitment No. NH/Rectt./05/2023-24.

Special Recruitment Drive for PwBD Candidates

Post Organization Category A Category B Total
Trainee Officer (HR) NHPC 1 1 2
Trainee Officer (Law) NHDC 1 0 1
Total 2 1 3

Candidates applying under the special recruitment drive should refer to the official notification for the identified benchmark disability categories. The Category B HR vacancy is a backlog vacancy. Reservation for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities is horizontal.

NHPC Trainee Officer Eligibility Criteria

Applicants must be Indian nationals, possess the prescribed full-time regular educational qualification and have a valid score in the relevant UGC NET June 2026 or CLAT PG 2026 examination. Final-year students are not eligible to apply.

Educational Qualification

Post Name Required Qualification Minimum Marks
Trainee Officer (HR) Two-year full-time regular postgraduate qualification in prescribed HR, personnel management or industrial relations disciplines; eligible MSW, MHROD, MBA HRD or MBA with HR as a major subject 60%
Trainee Officer (PR) Two-year full-time regular PG Degree or PG Diploma in Communication, Mass Communication, Journalism or Public Relations 60%
Trainee Officer (Law) Full-time regular three-year LLB or five-year integrated professional Law degree from a recognized university or institution recognized by the Bar Council of India 60%

SC, ST and PwBD candidates are eligible to apply with a minimum of 50% marks in the qualifying educational examination. Only the disciplines specifically mentioned in the official advertisement are accepted.

Detailed Qualification for HR Trainee Officers

Candidates applying for the HR discipline must possess one of the following prescribed full-time regular two-year qualifications from a recognized Indian university or eligible AICTE-approved institution:

  • Postgraduate Degree, Postgraduate Diploma or Postgraduate Program in Management with specialization in Human Resource, Human Resource Management, Human Resource Management and Labor Relations, Industrial Relations, Personnel Management, Personnel Management and Industrial Relations, or Industrial Relations and Personnel Management.
  • Master of Social Work with specialization in Personnel Management and Industrial Relations.
  • Master of Human Resource and Organizational Developments (MHROD), now known as MBA HRD.
  • MBA with specialization in Human Resource as a major subject.

Candidates holding qualifications in disciplines not specifically listed in the notification are not eligible, even if those disciplines are considered equivalent.

NHPC Recruitment Through UGC NET and CLAT PG 2026

NHPC accepts UGC NET June 2026 scores for Trainee Officer (HR) and Trainee Officer (PR) posts. Candidates applying for Trainee Officer (Law) must possess a valid CLAT PG 2026 score.

Post Name Qualifying Examination Subject Code Subject
Trainee Officer (HR) UGC NET June 2026 55 Labour Welfare, Personnel Management, Industrial Relations, Labour and Social Welfare or HR Management
Trainee Officer (PR) UGC NET June 2026 63 Mass Communication and Journalism
Trainee Officer (Law) CLAT PG 2026 Not applicable Postgraduate Common Law Admission Test

Only scores from the specified examination session are valid for this recruitment. Applications containing an invalid UGC NET June 2026 or CLAT PG 2026 registration number will be rejected.

Age Limit and Relaxation

The maximum age limit for NHPC Trainee Officer Recruitment 2026 is 30 years as of 26 December 2026, the closing date of online applications. Reserved category candidates are eligible for relaxation under the conditions specified in the advertisement.

Category Upper Age Relaxation Maximum Age
UR / EWS No category-based relaxation 30 Years
OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) 3 Years 33 Years
SC / ST 5 Years 35 Years
PwBD (General) 10 Years 40 Years
PwBD (OBC NCL) 13 Years 43 Years
PwBD (SC / ST) 15 Years 45 Years
Eligible Jammu and Kashmir Domicile Candidates 5 Years Subject to applicable conditions
Ex-Servicemen As per Government guidelines As applicable

The Jammu and Kashmir domicile relaxation applies to candidates who were ordinarily domiciled in the state between 1 January 1980 and 31 December 1989.

NHPC Trainee Officer Salary 2026

NHPC Trainee Officers will receive a pay scale of Rs. 50,000 to Rs. 1,60,000 under E2 Grade with a 3% increment structure (IDA). The approximate total annual emoluments for newly appointed candidates will be Rs. 16 to 17 lakh.

Salary Component Details
Grade E2
Pay Scale Rs. 50,000 – 3% – Rs. 1,60,000 (IDA)
Annual Emoluments Approximately Rs. 16–17 Lakh
Training Period 1 Year
Probation Period After Training 1 Year

In addition to basic pay, employees will receive benefits and allowances in accordance with company rules, including:

  • Dearness Allowance (DA)
  • House Rent Allowance (HRA)
  • Cafeteria Allowance
  • Performance Related Pay (PRP)
  • Medical facilities
  • Provident Fund, pension and gratuity

After successfully completing one year of training, candidates will be absorbed as Officers in the same pay scale and placed on probation for one year.

Application Fee

General, EWS and OBC Non-Creamy Layer candidates must pay a non-refundable application fee of Rs. 708, including applicable taxes. SC, ST, Women, PwBD and Ex-Servicemen candidates are exempted from payment of the registration fee.

Category Application Fee
UR / EWS / OBC (NCL) Rs. 708 (Rs. 600 plus applicable taxes)
SC / ST / Women / PwBD / Ex-Servicemen Nil

Additional bank charges, processing charges and applicable GST on such charges, if any, must be borne by the candidate. The application fee is non-refundable.

Candidates applying for Trainee Officer (Law) vacancies in both NHPC and NHDC must submit separate applications and pay the applicable fee separately for each application.

NHPC Trainee Officer Selection Process 2026

The selection process consists of shortlisting based on UGC NET June 2026 or CLAT PG 2026 marks, followed by a Group Discussion and Personal Interview. The qualifying examination score carries 75% weightage in the final selection process.

Selection Weightage

Selection Component Weightage
UGC NET June 2026 / CLAT PG 2026 Score 75%
Group Discussion 5%
Personal Interview 20%
Total 100%

Shortlisting and Final Selection

  1. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their marks in the relevant UGC NET June 2026 or CLAT PG 2026 examination.
  2. Normally, candidates numbering up to five times the available vacancies will be shortlisted for Group Discussion and Personal Interview.
  3. Candidates securing equal marks in the same discipline and category at the shortlisting threshold may be called even if the prescribed ratio is exceeded.
  4. Shortlisted candidates must submit the required consent form and attend the Group Discussion and Personal Interview.
  5. Candidates may also be required to undergo an online or offline psychometric assessment, the results of which will be used as an input during the interview.
  6. Final selection will be based on composite merit, applicable reservation requirements, document verification and other prescribed eligibility conditions.
  7. Selected candidates must satisfy NHPC or NHDC medical fitness requirements.

Minimum Qualifying Marks for GD and Interview

Category Minimum Combined GD and PI Score
UR / OBC (NCL) / EWS 40%
SC / ST / PwBD 30%

There is no separate qualifying cutoff for Group Discussion. Candidates must secure the prescribed minimum combined score in Group Discussion and Personal Interview to be considered for empanelment.

If two or more candidates secure the same final marks, the older candidate will receive preference in determining the merit position.

Service Agreement and Surety Bond

Selected candidates must execute a service agreement and surety bond to complete a minimum of four years of service with the company, including the training period.

Category Service Bond Amount Minimum Service Period
UR / OBC (NCL) / EWS Rs. 4,00,000 plus applicable GST 4 Years
SC / ST / PwBD Rs. 2,00,000 plus applicable GST 4 Years

NHPC Trainee Officer Job Location

Selected Trainee Officers may be posted at NHPC projects, power stations, offices, joint ventures or subsidiary companies in various parts of India or abroad. The placement will be determined according to organizational requirements.

Candidates interested in similar public sector and government employment opportunities can also check the latest government job notifications.

NHPC Recruitment 2026 Important Dates

Online registration for NHPC Trainee Officer posts will begin at 10:00 AM on 27 November 2026. The application window will close at 5:00 PM on 26 December 2026.

Event Date and Time
Notification Release Date 25 November 2026
Starting Date to Apply Online 27 November 2026 (10:00 AM)
Last Date to Apply Online 26 December 2026 (5:00 PM)

The Group Discussion and Personal Interview schedule will be communicated to shortlisted candidates through their registered email addresses.

NHPC Trainee Officer Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF

The official NHPC Trainee Officer notification was issued on 25 November 2026 under Advertisement No. NH/Talent Acquisition/08/2026. It contains discipline-wise vacancies, qualification requirements, qualifying examination details, selection weightage, salary, reservation provisions and application instructions.

Candidates should read the complete advertisement available through the Careers section of the official NHPC website before submitting their applications.

NHPC Trainee Officer Apply Online 2026

The online application facility for NHPC Trainee Officer Recruitment 2026 is scheduled to open on 27 November 2026 at 10:00 AM. Candidates with the prescribed qualifications and valid qualifying examination scores can apply through nhpcindia.com until 26 December 2026 at 5:00 PM.

Only online applications will be accepted. Candidates are not required to send printed application forms or supporting documents through the post.

How to Apply for NHPC Trainee Officer Recruitment 2026?

  1. Visit the official NHPC website at www.nhpcindia.com.
  2. Navigate to the Careers section.
  3. Locate Advertisement No. NH/Talent Acquisition/08/2026.
  4. Read the detailed recruitment notification and confirm your eligibility.
  5. Access the online application form for the relevant Trainee Officer discipline.
  6. Enter your personal, educational and qualifying examination registration details.
  7. Upload the required certificates, recent photograph and signature in the prescribed formats.
  8. Pay the applicable non-refundable application fee, if required.
  9. Submit the completed application form before the closing date.
  10. Download and retain the system-generated registration slip for future reference.

Documents Required for Online Application

  • Matriculation or Secondary School Certificate as proof of date of birth.
  • Class 12, graduation and postgraduate mark sheets and certificates, as applicable.
  • Valid UGC NET June 2026 or CLAT PG 2026 scorecard.
  • Category certificate in the prescribed format, if applicable.
  • Disability certificate issued by the competent authority, if applicable.
  • Certificate confirming full-time regular education.
  • CGPA or grade-to-percentage conversion certificate, where applicable.
  • No Objection Certificate for eligible candidates employed in Government Departments, PSUs or Autonomous Bodies, as applicable.
  • Recent passport-size colour photograph and signature.
  • Other applicable declarations and certificates prescribed in the official advertisement.

Document Upload Specifications

Document File Format File Size
Educational and Supporting Certificates PDF 100–400 KB Each
Passport-Size Photograph JPEG Less than 50 KB
Signature JPEG Less than 25 KB

Candidates must upload readable scanned documents. Incomplete applications or applications containing invalid qualifying examination registration numbers are liable to be rejected.

What Are State PSC Jobs?

State PSC jobs are government recruitment opportunities notified through State Public Service Commissions. These commissions recruit candidates for various posts and services under state government departments according to the rules applicable to each recruitment.

State PSC recruitment is not limited to State Civil Services examinations. Public Service Commissions may also recruit candidates for engineering, medical, teaching, agriculture, legal, scientific, technical, administrative and other departmental posts.

The posts available depend on vacancies reported by the respective state government departments and the recruitment notifications issued by the commission.

Popular Posts Recruited Through State PSCs

State Public Service Commissions recruit candidates for a wide range of government posts. Common recruitment categories may include:

  • State Civil Services
  • Administrative Services
  • Assistant Commissioner
  • Assistant Director
  • Assistant Professor
  • Lecturer
  • Medical Officer
  • Veterinary Officer
  • Assistant Engineer
  • Assistant Executive Engineer
  • Agriculture Officer
  • Food Safety Officer
  • Drug Inspector
  • Scientific Officer
  • Law Officer
  • Labour Officer
  • Revenue-related Posts
  • Technical Officers
  • Departmental Officers

The actual posts available vary by commission and recruitment notification.

PSC Jobs by Group (Group 1, 2, 2A, 4 & Others)

Several State Public Service Commissions including TNPSC, APPSC, and TSPSC classify recruitment into numbered "Groups" based on post seniority, pay scale, and administrative responsibility. Understanding these groups helps candidates identify which exam to prepare for based on their qualification and career goals.

Group Typical Posts Minimum Qualification Selection Stages
Group 1 Deputy Collector, DSP, Assistant Commissioner, District Registrar Bachelor's degree Prelims + Mains + Interview
Group 2 Assistant Section Officer, Tehsildar, Municipal Commissioner (Grade), Block Development Officer Bachelor's degree Prelims + Mains (some states include Interview)
Group 2A Junior Assistant, Bill Collector, Field Surveyor Bachelor's degree Written Exam (Certificate Verification)
Group 3 Various department Grade II/Non-Gazetted posts Varies by post Written Exam
Group 4 Junior Assistant, Typist, Steno-Typist, Bill Collector, Record Clerk, Village Administrative Officer (VAO) SSLC / 10th or 12th pass (varies by post) Single Written Exam (Certificate Verification)

Group numbering, post names, and minimum qualifications vary by state the table above reflects the common pattern used by TNPSC-style classification. Some states use different group labels or don't use numbered groups at all. Always confirm the exact group structure and eligibility on your state PSC's official notification.

Who Should Apply for Group 4?

Group 4 posts are typically entry-level government jobs open to candidates who have completed SSLC (10th) or Higher Secondary (12th), making them one of the most accessible and high-demand categories of PSC recruitment. These posts don't usually require a specific degree, have a single-stage written exam, and see some of the highest applicant volumes of any PSC exam due to the lower qualification bar and large number of annual vacancies.

State PSC Eligibility Criteria

There is no single eligibility rule for all State PSC jobs. Qualification, age limit, experience and other conditions differ depending on the commission and post.

Eligibility Criteria General Guidance
Educational Qualification Depends on the post and may include Diploma, Graduation, Engineering, Medicine, Law, Post Graduation or another prescribed qualification.
Age Limit Minimum and maximum age limits vary by commission and recruitment.
Age Relaxation Relaxation may be available to eligible categories according to the rules applicable to the recruitment.
State / Domicile Conditions State-specific eligibility, reservation, language or residency conditions may apply to certain recruitments.
Experience Some technical, teaching, specialist or senior posts require relevant professional experience.
Number of Attempts Attempt restrictions apply only where specifically prescribed for an examination or recruitment.

Important: Candidates should check the detailed recruitment notification before applying because eligibility conditions differ for every State PSC recruitment.

State PSC Selection Process

The State PSC selection process depends on the commission and the type of post. There is no single selection procedure followed for every PSC recruitment.

Depending on the recruitment, the selection process may include one or more of the following stages:

  • Preliminary Examination
  • Main Examination
  • Written Examination
  • Screening Test
  • Subject-specific Examination
  • Skill Test
  • Physical Test
  • Interview / Personality Test
  • Document Verification
  • Medical Examination

State Civil Services examinations may have Preliminary, Main and Interview stages, while technical, medical, teaching and departmental recruitment may follow a different selection process.

Always check the individual recruitment notification for the exact examination and selection procedure.

How to Apply for State PSC Jobs 2026

The application process differs slightly between commissions, but candidates can generally follow these steps:

  1. Find the required State PSC recruitment from the latest jobs table above.
  2. Open the detailed recruitment page.
  3. Check the post name, vacancies, qualification, age limit, application fee and important dates.
  4. Read the official recruitment notification carefully.
  5. Open the official application website or application link.
  6. Complete registration or One-Time Registration if required by the commission.
  7. Enter the required personal, educational and category details.
  8. Upload the prescribed photograph, signature and supporting documents.
  9. Pay the application fee if applicable.
  10. Review the application before final submission.
  11. Submit the application before the specified last date.
  12. Save or print the submitted application for future reference.

Candidates should submit applications only through the application method specified in the official notification.

State PSC Exam Pattern and Syllabus

There is no common exam pattern or syllabus for all State PSC recruitments.

State Civil Services examinations generally cover broader subjects such as General Studies and state-specific topics, while technical, medical, engineering, teaching and departmental recruitment may focus more heavily on subjects related to the post.

The following can differ between recruitments:

  • Number of papers
  • Objective or descriptive examination
  • Total marks
  • Exam duration
  • Negative marking
  • Minimum qualifying marks
  • Language requirements
  • Subject-specific syllabus
  • Interview or skill test requirements

Candidates should refer to the syllabus and exam pattern issued for the specific State PSC recruitment they are applying for.

State PSC Jobs vs UPSC Jobs

State Public Service Commissions and the Union Public Service Commission conduct different recruitment processes.

State PSC UPSC
Conducts recruitment for posts and services connected with the respective state. Conducts recruitment and examinations for various Union Government and All India Services posts.
Recruitment rules differ from one State PSC to another. Recruitment is conducted under the rules applicable to UPSC examinations and vacancies.
May recruit for State Civil Services, engineering, medical, teaching, technical and departmental posts. Conducts Civil Services Examination and various other recruitment examinations for Union Government posts.

Candidates looking for Union Government recruitment through UPSC can visit the UPSC Jobs page.

PSC vs PCS - What Is the Difference?

PSC stands for Public Service Commission. It refers to the constitutional commission responsible for conducting recruitment for various government posts and services within its jurisdiction.

PCS commonly refers to Provincial Civil Service or State Civil Services posts and examinations.

A State Public Service Commission may conduct a State Civil Services or PCS examination, but it can also conduct recruitment for many other positions such as Medical Officer, Assistant Engineer, Lecturer, Agriculture Officer and departmental posts.

Therefore, State PSC Jobs covers a broader range of recruitment than only PCS or State Civil Services examinations.

How to Choose the Right State PSC Recruitment

Before applying for a State PSC vacancy, candidates should compare the recruitment requirements with their qualification and preferences.

Check the following details:

  • Required educational qualification
  • Age limit
  • Category and reservation conditions
  • State or language requirements, if any
  • Number of vacancies
  • Pay scale or salary
  • Job location
  • Application fee
  • Selection process
  • Examination pattern
  • Application deadline

Apply only after confirming that you meet the eligibility conditions mentioned in the official recruitment notification.

State PSC Recruitment Updates You Should Check

A recruitment notification can sometimes be followed by additional notices from the commission. Candidates should continue checking recruitment updates even after submitting their application.

Important updates may include:

  • Application date extension
  • Correction window
  • Vacancy revision
  • Exam date
  • Exam city information
  • Admit card
  • Answer key
  • Result
  • Interview schedule
  • Document verification schedule
  • Final selection result

Relevant updates should be linked from the individual recruitment page whenever they are released.

Why Check State PSC Jobs on OnlyJobs?

OnlyJobs brings State Public Service Commission recruitment information together in one place so candidates can quickly find current opportunities without checking multiple commission websites individually.

For each recruitment, candidates can find important details such as:

  • Recruiting commission
  • Post name
  • Total vacancies
  • Educational qualification
  • Age limit
  • Salary or pay scale
  • Application fee
  • Selection process
  • Application dates
  • Official notification
  • Official application link

Recruitment information should be checked against the official State Public Service Commission notification before publication. Important corrections, vacancy revisions and date extensions should also be updated whenever they are released.

Latest State PSC Notifications - Frequently Asked Questions

What are State PSC Jobs?

State PSC Jobs are government recruitment opportunities notified through State Public Service Commissions for various posts and services under state government departments.

Which State PSC jobs are currently open?

Currently open recruitments are listed in the Latest State PSC Jobs 2026 table at the top of this page. The list is updated when new recruitment notifications and application updates are released.

Where can I find the latest State PSC recruitment notifications?

You can check the latest State PSC recruitment notifications on this page or select your commission from the State-wise PSC Jobs section to find recruitment specific to your state.

What qualification is required for State PSC jobs?

There is no single qualification required for all State PSC jobs. Depending on the post, candidates may need a Diploma, Graduation, Engineering degree, Medical qualification, Law degree, Post Graduation or another specified qualification.

Are all State PSC jobs for graduates?

No. Eligibility depends on the individual recruitment. Many administrative posts require a degree, while technical, professional and departmental posts may have different qualification requirements.

What is the age limit for State PSC jobs?

The minimum and maximum age limits vary according to the commission and post. Candidates should check the age criteria given in the individual recruitment notification.

Is age relaxation available for State PSC recruitment?

Age relaxation may be available to eligible categories according to the rules applicable to the respective recruitment. The exact relaxation should be checked in the official notification.

Is domicile compulsory for State PSC jobs?

Not for every State PSC recruitment. Some vacancies may have state-specific residency, reservation, language or other eligibility requirements. Candidates should check the relevant recruitment rules before applying.

What is the selection process for State PSC jobs?

The selection process varies by post. It may include a Preliminary Examination, Main Examination, written test, screening test, skill test, interview, physical test, document verification or medical examination.

Do all State PSC recruitments have Prelims and Mains?

No. Prelims and Mains are common in some State Civil Services examinations, but many technical, medical, teaching and departmental recruitments follow a different examination or selection process.

How can I apply for State PSC recruitment?

Open the required recruitment from the latest jobs table, read the eligibility and application details, check the official notification and use the official application link provided on the recruitment page.

What is the difference between State PSC and UPSC?

State PSCs conduct recruitment mainly for posts and services connected with their respective states, while UPSC conducts recruitment and examinations for various Union Government and All India Services posts.

Is PSC the same as PCS?

No. PSC means Public Service Commission, while PCS generally refers to Provincial Civil Service or State Civil Services. A State PSC can recruit for PCS as well as many other administrative, technical, medical and departmental posts.

Where can I check State PSC admit cards?

When an admit card is released, the related recruitment page should be updated with the admit card information and official download link. Candidates can also check the OnlyJobs Admit Card section.

Where can I check State PSC results?

State PSC result updates can be checked through the individual recruitment page or the OnlyJobs Results section.

How often is this State PSC Jobs page updated?

The page is updated when new State PSC recruitment notifications, application extensions and other important recruitment updates become available.

What Is a Bharat Sarkari Job?

A Bharat Sarkari Job is any government job opportunity offered across India's central and state government departments - spanning all 28 states and 8 union territories. The term "Bharat" simply emphasises pan-India coverage: a Bharat Sarkari Job notification could originate from a central body like the SSC, UPSC, or Indian Railways, or from a state public service commission recruiting for state-level posts. Regardless of origin, these roles share the defining traits Indian aspirants seek - long-term job security, government pay scales, and statutory retirement benefits.

Sarkari Job vs Private Job

A sarkari job differs from private-sector employment in a few important ways: government positions are governed by service rules that protect against arbitrary termination, salaries follow Pay Commission recommendations rather than market negotiation, and employees are entitled to pension schemes (NPS or OPS depending on recruitment year), medical coverage under CGHS, and fixed working hours. Private jobs, by contrast, often offer higher starting pay in competitive fields but carry less structural job security.

Sarkari Bharat Vacancies by Sector

Sarkari bharat vacancies span several major recruiting sectors. Each sector below links to a dedicated hub page with sector-specific notifications, eligibility criteria, and exam patterns.

Banking Jobs (IBPS, SBI, RBI)

Banking recruitment includes IBPS PO, IBPS Clerk, SBI PO, SBI Clerk, RBI Assistant, and NABARD postings. These roles are among the most competitive sarkari bharat jobs, offering strong starting pay and clear promotion tracks. Browse current openings on our Banking Jobs hub.

Railway Jobs (RRB NTPC, ALP, Group D)

Indian Railways is the country's largest single recruiter, with RRB NTPC, Group D, ALP, JE, and Technician posts opening in large batches. Check live Railway vacancies on our Railway Jobs hub.

Defence Jobs (Army, Navy, Air Force)

Defence recruitment covers Indian Army (including Agniveer), Navy, Air Force, BSF, CRPF, CISF, and ITBP postings. See ongoing openings on our Defence Jobs hub.

Teaching Jobs (KVS, NVS, State Boards)

Teaching sarkari jobs include KVS, NVS, DSSSB, and state education board recruitment for TGT, PGT, and PRT posts. Explore current teaching vacancies on our Teaching Jobs hub.

SSC & UPSC Notifications

SSC (CGL, CHSL, MTS, GD) and UPSC (Civil Services, CDS, NDA) notifications remain the most closely tracked central-government exams. Full notification archives are available on our SSC Jobs and UPSC Jobs hubs.

सरकारी फॉर्म ऑनलाइन 2026 कैसे भरें? (How to Apply Online)

हर साल लाखों उम्मीदवार सरकारी फॉर्म ऑनलाइन 2026 भरने की प्रक्रिया में गलतियाँ कर बैठते हैं, जिससे उनका आवेदन रद्द हो सकता है। नीचे दी गई सरल प्रक्रिया से आप अपना फॉर्म सही तरीके से भर सकते हैं।

आवेदन की चरणबद्ध प्रक्रिया

  1. संबंधित विभाग की आधिकारिक अधिसूचना (Notification PDF) ध्यान से पढ़ें और अपनी पात्रता जांचें।
  2. वैध ईमेल आईडी और मोबाइल नंबर से पोर्टल पर पंजीकरण (Registration) करें।
  3. व्यक्तिगत विवरण, शैक्षणिक योग्यता, और आवश्यक दस्तावेज़ अपलोड करें (फोटो, हस्ताक्षर, प्रमाणपत्र)।
  4. निर्धारित आवेदन शुल्क का ऑनलाइन भुगतान करें और भुगतान की रसीद सुरक्षित रखें।
  5. फॉर्म सबमिट करने से पहले सभी जानकारी की दोबारा जांच करें और फॉर्म का प्रिंटआउट अवश्य लें।

Documents Required for Sarkari Form

Typical documents needed: recent passport-size photograph (as per specified size/format), scanned signature, educational certificates and mark sheets, category certificate (if applicable), and a valid ID proof (Aadhaar/PAN).

Common Mistakes to Avoid While Applying

  • Submitting a photo or signature that doesn't match the specified pixel/size requirements.
  • Missing the last date due to server load - apply at least 2–3 days before deadline.
  • Entering a name or date of birth that doesn't match your certificates exactly.
  • Forgetting to download and save the final submitted form and payment receipt.

Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 FAQs

What is the last date for Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?

There is no common last date for Anganwadi Recruitment 2026. Each state or district publishes its own closing date. Check the live recruitment table for the applicable notification.

Where can I apply for Anganwadi jobs online in 2026?

Apply through the official state or district recruitment portal mentioned in the specific advertisement. Some Anganwadi recruitments require offline applications instead.

Is Anganwadi Supervisor Vacancy 2026 available?

Supervisor vacancies are announced separately by the relevant recruitment authorities. Candidates should confirm an active Supervisor notification before applying.

What is the last date for Anganwadi Supervisor Vacancy 2026?

The last date depends on the state and the Supervisor advertisement. Worker and Helper application deadlines do not automatically apply to Supervisor posts.

Can 10th or 12th pass candidates apply for Anganwadi jobs?

Yes, some Anganwadi Worker and Helper notifications accept Class 10 or Class 12 qualifications. The required qualification depends on the post and recruiting authority.

Is there an examination for Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?

The selection method depends on the official notification. Candidates should check whether the recruitment involves academic merit, a written examination, interview or other prescribed stages.

How can I find Anganwadi Vacancy 2026 in Haryana or Telangana?

Check the state-wise recruitment section and open the relevant district notification. Verify the post, vacancy, deadline and application mode before applying.

Where can I find Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 in Maharashtra?

Check the relevant Maharashtra Women and Child Development or district recruitment notification for Anganwadi Sevika, Helper and Supervisor vacancies, as applicable.

Is wcd.gov.in the Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 official website?

The central Ministry of Women and Child Development website is wcd.gov.in. Recruitment application portals differ by state and district, so applicants must use the portal specified in their notification.

Can I apply for an Anganwadi vacancy in another district?

That depends on the recruitment's residence and eligibility rules. Some Worker and Helper notices require candidates to belong to a particular village, ward or project area.
